[95563 Data Driven Storytelling Studio | Subject description]
Credit points: 6

This studio subject focuses on crafting interactive, data-driven storytelling, an approach gaining traction across news, media, journalism, and marketing. You'll delve into the storytelling creation process, backed by data visualization and human-centered design, and collaborate on projects. Hands-on experience with a Business Intelligence platform will enhance your data storytelling and problem-solving skills. This subject is suitable if you have prior knowledge of data analytics and want to further improve your story telling skills using data.

[95563 Data Driven Storytelling Studio | Learning and teaching activities]
This project-based studio requires students to collaborate in project teams and individually develop a data-driven narrative. 

The semester is organised into 4 stages. At each stage, teams are required to submit evidence of their progress for feedback. They are to incorporate the feedback to make iterations for improvement. A specifications grading rubric is available for students to gauge their performance level against each stage and submission throughout the semester. 

 This studio subject includes a weekly 2-hour face-to-face studio session throughout the session. This weekly studio class structure is supported by weekly activities and readings. Students will gain the most from the studio sessions if they prepare in advance and participate in the online discussions. Readings will be made available using Canvas. Canvas will also be used in this subject for online activities, teamwork and discussions and subject announcements. 

Students are expected to attend and participate in all studio sessions, actively participate in their team for the team project, and complete artefacts per stage by their due dates. Individual contributions within the team effort will be considered and marked individually.

title: Learning outcomes
content:
[95563 Data Driven Storytelling Studio | Learning outcomes]
SLO1: Reflect on ethical practices when working with Indigenous Australians' data. (A.1)
SLO2: Examine the user experience of a data-driven narrative and adapt its design in response. Deliver a compelling storytelling presentation. (B.1)
SLO3: Create and design effective data-driven narratives. (C.1)
SLO4: Create visual artefacts using a range of data sources. (D.1)
SLO5: Communicate effectively in a collaborative environment to formulate computing science problems. (E.1)
SLO6: Self-review personal performance in terms of problem-solving, professional skills, and contribution to team success. (F.1)
